title: Design: the lines table's columns keep their place while Add Part is open
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with a part on line 1.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Take a screenshot of the lines table headings.
  3. Click Add Part under line 1.
  4. Take a screenshot of the headings.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Take a screenshot of the headings.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The first screenshot matches picture 10.5's headings.

Step 3:

  • The Add Part row opens under line 1.

Step 4:

  • Compared with the first screenshot, Name/Description, Actual/Estimate, Progress, Status, Action and Rate keep their place and width: nothing moves sideways or down.
  • The Add Part row shows its boxes under line 1.

Step 5:

  • The Add Part row closes.

Step 6:

  • The headings are in the same place as the first screenshot.
